headline_marked: Liton Das named [[new ODI captain of Bangladesh]]
headline: Liton Das named new ODI captain of Bangladesh
summary: Replacing Mehidy Hasan Miraz, Liton Das now leads both the T20I and ODI squads as the BCB announces leadership changes.
details: Liton Das has been appointed as the new captain of the Bangladesh ODI team, replacing Mehidy Hasan Miraz.
Liton was already leading the T20I squad, and he will now take charge of both white-ball formats of the game.
Tawhid Hridoy has been named as the vice-captain for the ODI team.
Nazmul Hossain remains the captain of the Test team.
The decision was made following a meeting of the BCB board of directors at the BCB office in Mirpur.
BCB President Tamim Iqbal stated that the board believes the team needs two separate captains for different formats.
caption:
Liton Das takes the helm of both white-ball formats! 🏏

Liton Das has been appointed as the new captain of the Bangladesh ODI team, replacing Mehidy Hasan Miraz.

Liton was already leading the T20I squad, and he will now take charge of both white-ball formats of the game.

Tawhid Hridoy has been named as the vice-captain for the ODI team.

Nazmul Hossain remains the captain of the Test team.

The decision was made following a meeting of the BCB board of directors at the BCB office in Mirpur.

BCB President Tamim Iqbal stated that the board believes the team needs two separate captains for different formats.

#Bangladesh #Cricket #BCB #LitonDas #ODI

Source: Prothom Alo

headline: PM Tarique Rahman meets Tahsin, boy who lost sister in Milestone tragedy
summary: After a viral photo of the boy's joyful smile at a sports event, the Prime Minister invited him and his family for a courtesy visit to the Secretariat.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman met with Tahsin Abdullah, a young boy who gained social media attention after a viral photo captured his joyful expression during a sports event on July 27.
caption:
A viral smile hid a heartbreaking story. Tahsin, who lost his sister in a tragic accident, meets Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman met with Tahsin Abdullah, a young boy who gained social media attention after a viral photo captured his joyful expression during a sports event on July 27.
